SELECT 
    d.name AS department,
    e.businessentityid,
    eph.rate,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY d.name ORDER BY eph.rate) AS cume_dist,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.name ORDER BY eph.rate) AS percent_rank
FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh
JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
JOIN humanresources.employeepayhistory eph ON edh.businessentityid = eph.businessentityid
JOIN humanresources.employee e ON edh.businessentityid = e.businessentityid
WHERE d.name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
ORDER BY d.name ASC, eph.rate DESC
